name: Scenario: 1. Position lifecycle trades preserve visible position semantics with position history enabled
Scenario: 2a. Leverage change does not exceed instantaneous-IM HWM already set by entry trades
Scenario: 2b. Leverage decrease exceeds instantaneous-IM HWM; subsequent increase does not lower it
Scenario: 3. Full close publishes position close pubs with both sides verified
Scenario: 4. Flip publishes close pubs and resets the new lifecycle accumulators
Scenario: 5. Positions opened before the history flag do not emit close pubs
Scenario: 6. maxOpenInterestQuote HWM preserved when position size decreases
Scenario: 7. Oscillating position size: maxIM tracks instantaneous peak, not cumulative sum
